narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Seven, with one left over, is seven point one metres.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Zero point one is one tenth of a metre.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Our share is one quarter of a metre, which is bigger than a tenth.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Make the bottom ten, a hundred or a thousand.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Multiply the top by the same number as the bottom.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. Nine metres of rope is shared among four friends. How much does each get?
